metadata.comment: DBU-11: every word that names the coach says $t(coachName) (mid-sentence) or $t(coachNameStart) (at the start of a sentence). i18next looks a nested $t() up in the DEFAULT namespace (common), whichever bundle the word is in, so the two keys live in common ("your coach"/"Your coach"). App reads the name the coach set in Settings (the public coachName function) and adds it to BOTH bundles: common holds the value, and adding to pages is what makes every Translation in pages say its word again.
